parsed.attack: Nobody receives an invitation - the corrected total is a private number for one nurse - so community_embed reduces to the founder posting into nursing forums that auto-remove app links. Worse, the payoff is invisible for the first two weeks: the promise is a corrected total 'after a run of nights', so the earliest moment a user has anything worth mentioning is a full rotation after install, by which point the idea's own kill criterion anticipates three quarters of installs no longer even have background delivery running. A loop whose first turn takes fourteen days and starts from an already-churned base cannot compound at any coefficient.
parsed.strongest_defence: Night-shift nursing is one of the most content-heavy occupational tribes on TikTok and in dedicated Facebook groups, and 'my ring finally counts my day sleep' is a screenshot with an instantly legible before and after that travels through a unit in a single shift.
parsed.verdict_reason: There is no loop, and the first shareable moment arrives a fortnight after install, past the point most installs have already stopped working.
